title: Dirty Weekend
writer: Ruggero Maccari, Dino Risi, Bernardino Zapponi
actors: Marcello Mastroianni, Oliver Reed, Carole André
plot: In 1970s Italy, an industrialist and his mistress are taken hostage by three left-wing extremists who robbed a bank but the police and a media circus follow them closely on a cross-country car chase.
